items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: I worked with Sidney a good while... I played quite a bit with him... Sidney Desmond was playing trumpet and myself.

ctx.x: When you were with them, did Sidney play much in style or did he play in the record?

Yes, no, Sidney was very active in the section. He played along with everybody else in the section. Well, we played arrangements, we played stocks and everything, you know? And I worked with Sidney a good while. And I made several little trips out of town, like to Morgan City and these little country towns or so like that with Sidney. I played quite a bit with him, right? Yeah, he was all right. Well, I mean, I can't say too much about Sidney. I know he played out on the boat a long time, too, on the steamer…
How big a band was the rest of them?
